name: Wanjiru K.
text: The balcony at sunrise is worth every shilling. Staff remembered my coffee order by day two — that never happens.

name: Daniel O.
text: Ran three days of board meetings here and the team still talks about the food. The rooftop pool at 6am is a secret worth keeping.

name: Amara & Felipe M.
text: Private plunge pool, sunset over the hills, champagne appearing as if by magic. We cancelled a safari day just to stay in.

name: Grace A.
text: The kids lived in the garden and pool. Kitchenette saved us a fortune and the staff treated them like royalty.

name: Jonas S.
text: Hosted our whole family in the villa for a week. The butler and chef service is the best value in East Africa, full stop.
